def complete_twin_sprite(grid, fill=1):
    """If the grid holds two shifted copies of one sprite pattern (same color, one truncated at the grid edge), complete the truncated copy from the full one; the added cells become fill."""
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    comps=components(grid)
    multi=[c for c in comps if len(c)>1]; single=[c for c in comps if len(c)==1]
    if len(multi)>2: return None
    if single:
        if len(multi)!=2: return None
        for c in single:
            def d(A): return min(abs(i-a)+abs(j-b) for a,b in A for i,j in c)
            min(multi,key=d).extend(c)
        comps=multi
    if len(comps)!=2 or len(comps[0])==len(comps[1]): return None
    S,T=(comps[0],comps[1]) if len(comps[0])>len(comps[1]) else (comps[1],comps[0])
    if len({grid[i][j] for i,j in S})!=1 or grid[S[0][0]][S[0][1]]!=grid[T[0][0]][T[0][1]]: return None
    Tset=set(T)
    r0,r1=min(i for i,_ in T),max(i for i,_ in T)
    c0,c1=min(j for _,j in T),max(j for _,j in T)
    for dr in range(-h,h+1):
        for dc in range(-w,w+1):
            if dr==dc==0: continue
            ok=True; fills=[]; covered=set()
            for i,j in S:
                i2,j2=i+dr,j+dc
                if not (0<=i2<h and 0<=j2<w): continue
                if grid[i2][j2]==0:
                    if r0<=i2<=r1 and c0<=j2<=c1: ok=False; break
                    fills.append((i2,j2))
                elif (i2,j2) in Tset and grid[i2][j2]==grid[i][j]: covered.add((i2,j2))
                else: ok=False; break
            if not (ok and len(fills)>=3): continue
            # fills must lie beyond one side of T's box
            sides=[all(j>c1 for _,j in fills), all(j<c0 for _,j in fills),
                   all(i>r1 for i,_ in fills), all(i<r0 for i,_ in fills)]
            if not any(sides): continue
            # uncovered T cells allowed only on the opposite boundary
            k=sides.index(True)
            opp={0:(lambda i,j: j==c0),1:(lambda i,j: j==c1),2:(lambda i,j: i==r0),3:(lambda i,j: i==r1)}[k]
            if all(opp(i,j) for i,j in Tset-covered):
                o=[r[:] for r in grid]
                for i,j in fills: o[i][j]=fill
                return o
    return None

def twin_fill(g, fill=1):
    """Two translated copies of one sprite sit in two disjoint row bands; one copy is truncated at the grid edge. Complete the truncated (smaller) copy from the fuller one; added cells become fill."""
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bs=bands_of(g)
    if len(bs)!=2: return None
    n0=sum(1 for i in bs[0] for j in range(w) if g[i][j])
    n1=sum(1 for i in bs[1] for j in range(w) if g[i][j])
    cands=[]
    for dr in (bs[1][0]-bs[0][0], bs[0][0]-bs[1][0]):
        src = n1 if dr>0 else n0
        tgt = n0 if dr>0 else n1
        if src <= tgt: continue
        for dc in range(-w,w+1):
            m,tot=band_match(g,dr,dc)
            if m>=0.9*min(n0,n1) and m>=10: cands.append((m,dr,dc))
    if not cands: return None
    m,dr,dc=max(cands)
    o=[r[:] for r in g]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]==0:
                i2,j2=i+dr,j+dc
                if 0<=i2<h and 0<=j2<w and g[i2][j2]: o[i][j]=fill
    return o if o!=g else None
